The lesson should explain what each important idea means, why it works, how the parts relate to one another, and where the idea appears in school, Ghanaian life, practical work or examinations. New terms should be introduced before they are used. Processes should be explained in sequence, and calculations should show the reason for every step.
step_by_step_concepts: Identify the main idea of Vocabulary.
Learn and explain the important terms in your own words.
Break the process or principle into logical steps.
Connect the idea to an observable or real-life example.
Apply the idea to structured examination questions.
ghana_real_life_applications: Relate Vocabulary to situations learners can observe in Ghanaian homes, schools, farms, workplaces, communities or the environment where appropriate.
worked_examples: Example 1: Explain Vocabulary using a familiar everyday situation.
Example 2: Apply Vocabulary to a WASSCE-style situation.
common_mistakes: Memorising definitions without understanding the idea.
Leaving out essential labels, units, conditions or explanations.
Giving an answer without showing the required reasoning or working.

The lesson should explain what each important idea means, why it works, how the parts relate to one another, and where the idea appears in school, Ghanaian life, practical work or examinations. New terms should be introduced before they are used. Processes should be explained in sequence, and calculations should show the reason for every step.

diagram_policy.no_placeholder_only: A diagram field must not merely say 'recommended diagram' when an actual educational visual is required.
